title: Sagan–Carlotto correspondence on the Face on Mars

tellings.quote: he even had correspondences with with Dr. Mark Carlott, one of the early researchers of the face on Mars, expressing interest in Carl's various analyses of the face on Mars.

plain: The astronomer Carl Sagan is said to have written letters to Mark Carlotto, one of the first researchers of the Face on Mars (a rock formation in NASA photos of Mars's Cydonia region that looks like a human face), and to have shown interest in the analyses of it. A researcher named Maaneli Derakhshani tells Michels this. He also names Gerald Soffen but does not say where the letters can be found. If true, Sagan took the Face more seriously in private than he did in public.
